changes: Keep heating cycles started before the sunrise saving window eligible for standard learning even when a saving forecast stops them.
Verify learning attribution and prediction feedback across the window boundary and document the change in the public changelog.
Reassess verifiable legacy sunrise exclusions once per curve store using the current window, preserving original evidence and applying standard heating quality checks.
Restore retained heating curves, runtime samples and recorded prediction comparisons without replaying truncated cooling observations.
Migrate stored cooling cycles with a verified target crossing and retained buckets, using an independent migration marker for stores already migrated for heating.
Move historical Peak timeout and sunrise heating/cooling recovery from startup to an administrator-only per-entry Migration button in Learning Analysis.
Report recovery counts and skipped or deferred steps while excluding overlapping learning resets and migrations.
Add a configurable learning-only grace period for heater outages and replay actual observations on same-state recovery.
Exclude unverified cycles when the heater state changes or the grace period expires while retaining the independent heater fault timer.
Recover historical heater outage exclusions from verified heater edges and indoor temperature Recorder history.
Keep heater, peak timeout, and sunrise recovery disjoint with source-reason checks and per-cycle audit evidence.
Cap continuous heater runtime at a configurable 60 to 180 minutes while fewer than ten heating cycles have been accepted.
Record cap-triggered stops and retain the standard coast observation and restart delay.
Suspend the initial runtime cap while an accepted predictive OFF cutoff is scheduled within one hour of confirmed ON.
Restore the original cap when the cutoff is withdrawn or no longer governs the decision.
Apply the configured maximum continuous runtime to every heating run regardless of learning count.
Keep saved runtime limit settings and allow earlier target or predictive stops.
Document maximum continuous runtime, heater outage learning grace, and historical outage recovery in the Korean and English user guides.
Use 5°C outdoor bands for heating runtime and residual models with separate ON-to-OFF mean and confirmed-OFF temperature evidence.
Recalculate retained heating weather from Recorder history through the Learning Analysis migration button and keep incomplete weather evidence in the shared model.
Display actual recent and long-term prediction weights by five-minute interval in Learning Analysis alongside the existing confidence scores.
Expose the heating preview and predictive ON cooling weights without changing the prediction calculation or control decisions.
Separate heating temperature offsets from operating times and protection in setup and options.
Add an optional weather entity selector for sunrise learning and preserve existing option keys and defaults.
Learn passive solar rise from five-minute heater-off observations and reuse peak confirmation.
Learn sunrise saving heating intervals and qualified residual samples separately from normal control learning.
Expose both sunrise curves and sample counts in Learning Analysis.
Prepare version 1.1.3 and update the public changelog and bilingual setup guides for outdoor correction, curve weights, and sunrise learning.
Use continuous outdoor weighting across retained runtime observations and reserve a supported OFF deadline before evaluating residual heat.
Allow weighted residual forecasts to advance a valid deadline with comparable observations, and keep default control and observation when evidence is insufficient.
Show the initial plan, residual decision evidence, and prediction coverage while preserving historical forecasts and learning data without migration.
Keep the initial OFF deadline visible during residual-driven control and show the stored decision, comparable cycle count, and abstention in completed prediction history.
Set the public integration version and README badge to 1.2.0 and document the updated OFF control and prediction analysis.
Consolidate the 1.1.3 public release notes into 1.2.0 and describe the current outdoor weighting and optional Recorder recovery.
Explain why sunrise observations are stored separately and how they can inform future sunrise shutdown decisions.
Store sustained cooling onset, 15-minute drop rates and cooling acceleration in accepted cycle diagnostics, independent of raw bucket retention and control predictions.
Document sustained cooling diagnostics in the 1.2.0 release notes and Korean and English operation guides.
Use the native Home Assistant climate temperature API when available while preserving compatibility with older Core versions.
Align English and Korean confirmation placeholders for initial setup and options changes.
Clarify operating-time units, final confirmation and post-update log messages in both guide languages, and match the English migration instructions to the sidebar label.
Record below-target cooling until confirmed heating resumes or the original lower threshold is observed, including across setpoint changes.
Use the configured temperature as the AUTO heating stop target between sunrise and sunset while sunrise saving is enabled.
Measure Climate actuator runtime between reported upper and lower setpoints, ignore internal heating action changes, and retain protection for unexpected HVAC OFF.
Document Climate setpoint-based runtime, retained learning, and fault checks in the Korean and English user guides.
Set the public integration version and README badge to 1.2.1.
Allow AUTO to resume after an external override interrupted AUTO once heater OFF is confirmed, while keeping the actuator restart deadline.
Clear the previous minimum OFF wait on reload or reinstallation when the heater was already OFF, and preserve cooldown when unloading stops active heating.
Clarify that HACS updates followed by a Home Assistant restart use the existing startup cooldown rules.
Defer external-override faults for ten seconds after heater communication recovers while stopping unexpected heating immediately.
